summary: A convincing version of events may start falling apart once you compare it with what was actually said, promised, or documented.
body: A convincing version of events may start falling apart once you compare it with what was actually said, promised, or documented. When Mercury opposes Neptune, facts and imagination face each other directly, making rumors, assumptions, selective memories, and emotionally satisfying explanations harder to separate from the record. A story can feel true and still contain details your mind supplied on its own. Strip away the emotional narrative and force the situation to stand entirely on its documented facts. Clarity returns the exact moment you stop doing the heavy lifting to make someone else's story make sense.
